items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject falsey non-list command_hooks values**

When a maintainer writes `command_hooks: {}` (or `false`, `""`, or `0`), `or []` converts that invalid manifest value into an empty list before the type check. The generator uses the same expression, so both rendering and validation succeed while silently dropping the intended hooks instead of reporting the malformed declaration. Read the raw value with only a missing-key default before checking that it is a list.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Cap SessionEnd and Interrupt hook timeouts at 3 seconds**

When a manifest declares a `SessionEnd` or `Interrupt` command hook with a timeout above 3 seconds (the new fixture declares `SessionEnd` with `10`), this validation accepts it and the renderer emits it. Codex supports those two event types only up to three seconds, so these hooks cannot receive their declared execution budget; reject those event-specific values here. [Codex hooks documentation](https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks/)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.body: fixed:9c2f82e5 — a missing `command_hooks` key still defaults to no hooks, but `{}`, `false`, `""` or `0` now fail validation ("must be a list") instead of being coerced to an empty list.
